musique.description:
Global Metadata: cinematic hybrid orchestral with pulsing electronic bass, 96 BPM, EN: Opens cold and sparse with felt piano and airy wind texture, then a ticking pulse and deep synth bass drive the board scenes, each tile marked by a bright pluck; full drums, low toms and a driving string ostinato for the job site; a warm solo piano breath for the evening at home; a final lift with big drums, warm brass and a wordless choir pad. Clean mix leaving room for a spoken voice, hard accents on the announced hits, ringing final chord. Loud polished master.

Vocal Details: Instrumental, no lyrics, no vocals, no choir.

Arrangement: [Intro] at 0 seconds: EN: cold felt piano, wind texture, single low drone [Pulse] at 2 seconds: EN: ticking hi-hat pulse, deep synth bass, bright plucks on each tile [Drive] at 15 seconds: EN: full drums and low toms enter, string ostinato, forward momentum [Rise] at 22 seconds: EN: strings swell upward, cymbal rolls, time-lapse energy [Breath] at 30 seconds: EN: drums drop out, warm solo piano with soft strings, intimate [Morning] at 34 seconds: EN: soft pulse returns under the piano, building anticipation [Finale] at 40 seconds: EN: big drum hit, warm brass, wordless choir pad, full and proud [Outro] at 45 seconds: EN: final ringing chord, long decay into silence Strong hits at 2.5, 15.0, 22.5, 30.0, 40.0, 45.0 seconds. Clean ending at 51 seconds.
